class.name: EretheaPreviewLoop
class.brief_description: The main loop that shows an [EretheaPreview] without a project.
class.description: The engine uses this main loop when it starts with [code]--erethea-preview=<file>[/code]. It adds an [EretheaPreview] to the root window, loads the asset, follows the other [code]--erethea-preview-*[/code] arguments (capture, control file and quality preset) and quits after saving the capture. Games don't need this class: use [EretheaPreview] in a scene instead. See "Prévia para a Fornalha" in [code]erethea/README.md[/code] for the arguments.
